# JAANA

> The official website of the Josephite Alumni Association of North America, serving alumni of St. Joseph's Boys' High School, Bangalore.

## Main sections

- [Home](https://jaana.co/): Association overview, current initiatives, and alumni highlights.
- [Causes](https://jaana.co/#causes): School and community causes supported by JAANA.
- [Donate](https://jaana.co/#donate): Ways to support JAANA and its causes.
- [North America Connect](https://jaana.co/#connect): Reunion information, registration, travel, and sponsors.
- [Josephite Store](https://jaana.co/josephite-store): Alumni merchandise reserved online for event pickup.
- [Contact](https://jaana.co/#contact): General and finance inquiry forms and contact channels.
- [Privacy policy](https://jaana.co/privacy-policy.html): How the website handles personal information.

## Contact

- General inquiries: jaanagroup@gmail.com
- Finance inquiries: jaanafinance@gmail.com
